verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents per-bank-account reconciliation: the Bank Accounts API can create and list bank reconciliations and get a statement summary, and the product imports bank feeds and categorizes them. Uncategorized transactions roughly correspond to an unmatched queue, but the evidence never describes a matched/unmatched review view, and duplicate detection is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: explicit matched-vs-unmatched review surface, duplicate transaction detection, ledger-to-bank matching workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Automatically import transactions, categorise them, and streamline the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing
